cards.english_title: The U.S. formally serves India in Pannun lawsuit
cards.korean_desc: 서류는 구르파트완트 싱 판눈의 민사소송과 관련됐다. 국무부는 법적으로 전달해야 하며 사건 지지는 아니라고 말했다. 인도 정부는 아직 이 사건에 논평하지 않았다.
cards.english_desc: The documents concerned Gurpatwant Singh Pannun’s civil lawsuit. The State Department said legal duty required the delivery, not support for the case. India’s government has not yet commented on the case.
cards.hook: The U.S. delivered India legal papers.
cards.takeaway_english: The next important step is India’s legal response.
cards.takeaway_korean: 다음 중요한 단계는 인도의 법적 대응이다.

why_it_matters.english: The notice moves a serious dispute between Washington and New Delhi into court.
why_it_matters.korean: 통지는 미국과 인도 갈등을 법정으로 옮겼다.

why_it_matters.english: The case connects an alleged assassination plot with international legal responsibility.
why_it_matters.korean: 사건은 암살 의혹과 국제적 책임을 연결한다.

parties.label: U.S. State Department
parties.english: It delivered the lawsuit documents and said it must do so legally.

parties.label: India
parties.english: Its government received the documents but has not commented on the case.

parties.label: Gurpatwant Singh Pannun
parties.english: He filed the civil lawsuit over an alleged assassination plot.
parties.korean: 판눈은 암살 음모 관련 소송을 냈다.

views.label: U.S. State Department
views.english: Serving notice was a legal duty, not a statement supporting Pannun’s claims.
views.korean: 전달은 법적 의무였고 판눈을 지지하지 않았다.

views.label: U.S. investigators
views.english: They allege an Indian businessman worked with an Indian government employee to hire a hitman.
views.korean: 수사관들은 인도인 두 명의 암살 계획을 주장한다.

disagree.english: India has not commented, so its legal position and response remain unclear.
disagree.korean: 인도가 말하지 않아 법적 입장은 불분명하다.

cards.reader_question_korean: 정부는 이런 소송에 공개 답변해야 할까요?

cards.english_title: Hegseth faces reporters as impeachment threat grows
cards.korean_desc: 피트 헤그세스가 11월 10일 국방부에서 브리핑한다. 그는 이란 전쟁과 탄핵 위협을 설명할 예정이다. 브리핑은 5월 이후 처음이다. 토머스 매시는 11월 9일 탄핵안을 냈다.
cards.english_desc: Pete Hegseth will brief reporters at the Pentagon on November 10, 2026. He plans to discuss the Iran war and the impeachment threat. This will be his first Pentagon briefing since May. Thomas Massie filed impeachment articles on November 9, 2026.
cards.hook: Hegseth returns to the Pentagon briefing room.
cards.takeaway_english: The briefing may show whether Hegseth can keep Republican support.
cards.takeaway_korean: 브리핑은 공화당 지지를 보여줄 수 있다.

why_it_matters.english: The dispute could affect U.S. military policy during an ongoing war.
why_it_matters.korean: 갈등은 전쟁 중 미국 군사정책에 영향을 준다.

why_it_matters.english: A House vote could test Republican support for Trump’s defense secretary.

parties.label: Pete Hegseth
parties.english: He plans to defend his military decisions and oppose impeachment.

parties.label: Thomas Massie
parties.english: He filed an impeachment resolution over the Iran war and other actions.
parties.korean: 매시는 이란 전쟁 관련 탄핵안을 냈다.

parties.label: Donald Trump
parties.english: He supports Hegseth and says the military actions succeeded.

views.label: Massie and supporters
views.english: They say Hegseth violated legal limits and deserves impeachment.

views.label: Hegseth and Trump
views.english: They say the military actions were necessary and successful.
views.korean: 그들은 군사 작전이 필요하고 성공했다고 말한다.

disagree.english: The legality and political cost of the war remain disputed.
disagree.korean: 전쟁의 합법성과 정치적 비용은 논쟁 중이다.

cards.reader_question_korean: 군사 결정은 탄핵 심사를 받아야 할까요?

cards.english_title: Massie forces a vote on Hegseth impeachment
cards.korean_desc: 토머스 매시가 11월 9일 헤그세스 탄핵안을 냈다. 결의안은 이란과 예멘, 베네수엘라를 다룬다. 매시는 헤그세스가 불법 명령을 실행했다고 말했다. 하원 표결은 이번 주 중반 가능하지만 결과는 불확실하다.
cards.english_desc: Thomas Massie introduced impeachment articles against Pete Hegseth on November 9, 2026. The resolution focuses on Iran and also mentions Yemen and Venezuela. Massie says Hegseth knowingly carried out unlawful orders. A House vote could come by midweek, but the outcome remains uncertain.
cards.hook: Massie wants the House to impeach Hegseth.
cards.takeaway_english: The House vote will show whether impeachment has bipartisan support.

why_it_matters.english: The vote could challenge presidential control over military action.
why_it_matters.korean: 표결은 대통령의 군사권을 시험할 수 있다.

why_it_matters.english: The Senate could later hold a trial if the House impeaches Hegseth.
why_it_matters.korean: 하원이 탄핵하면 상원이 재판할 수 있다.

parties.label: Thomas Massie
parties.english: He introduced impeachment articles and accused Hegseth of unlawful actions.
parties.korean: 매시는 불법 행동을 주장하며 탄핵안을 냈다.

parties.label: Pete Hegseth
parties.english: He rejects the charges and says the military actions were necessary.

parties.label: Republican leaders
parties.english: They worry the vote could damage the party during foreign hostilities.

views.label: Massie and Democrats
views.english: They say Hegseth violated the Constitution and should face trial.
views.korean: 그들은 헌법 위반으로 재판해야 한다고 말한다.

views.label: Republican leaders
views.english: They say impeachment during foreign hostilities would harm the country’s image.
views.korean: 그들은 전쟁 중 탄핵이 국가 이미지를 해친다고 말한다.

disagree.english: Supporters of impeachment say constitutional concerns matter even during war.
disagree.korean: 탄핵 지지자들은 전쟁 중에도 헌법이 중요하다고 말한다.

cards.reader_question_korean: 전쟁 중 당 지도자는 표결을 막아야 할까요?

cards.english_title: Russia, Ukraine and the U.S. reopen peace talks
cards.korean_desc: 이틀 회담은 안보 보장에 초점을 둔다. 러시아는 우크라이나 철수와 완전한 평화협정을 요구한다. 우크라이나는 영토 포기와 군사 제한을 거부한다.
cards.english_desc: The two-day meeting will focus on security guarantees. Russia demands Ukrainian withdrawals and rejects a simple ceasefire. Ukraine rejects giving up territory or limiting its military.
cards.hook: Russia, Ukraine and the U.S. meet in Abu Dhabi.
cards.takeaway_english: The talks restart diplomacy, but the central demands remain unresolved.
cards.takeaway_korean: 회담은 외교를 재개했지만 핵심 요구는 남았다.

why_it_matters.english: Any agreement could shape Ukraine’s territory, military and future alliances.
why_it_matters.korean: 합의는 우크라이나 영토와 군사에 영향을 준다.

why_it_matters.english: Security guarantees could affect Europe’s future security system.
why_it_matters.korean: 안보 보장은 유럽 안보체계에 영향을 준다.

parties.label: Russia
parties.english: It demands Ukrainian withdrawals, military limits and no NATO membership.
parties.korean: 러시아는 영토 철수와 군사 제한을 요구한다.

parties.label: Ukraine
parties.english: It rejects giving up territory and wants security guarantees.
parties.korean: 우크라이나는 영토 포기와 군사 제한을 거부한다.

parties.label: United States
parties.english: Its envoys are mediating talks about security guarantees and peace.

views.label: Russia
views.english: Moscow says a full peace deal must meet its territorial and security demands.
views.korean: 러시아는 평화협정이 요구를 반영해야 한다고 말한다.

views.label: Ukraine
views.english: Kyiv says a ceasefire should come first and territory cannot be surrendered.

disagree.english: The sides remain far apart, so renewed talks do not show agreement.

cards.english_title: G7 debates Ukraine as Abu Dhabi talks begin
cards.korean_desc: G7 외교관들이 11월 10일 파리에서 우크라이나 장관을 만났다. 그들은 우크라이나 국방 지원과 미래 안보를 논의했다. 유럽 officials는 본회담 밖에서 안보 보장을 논의한다. 러시아는 본협상에 유럽이 참여하는 것을 여전히 반대한다.
cards.english_desc: G7 diplomats met Ukraine’s foreign minister in Paris on November 10, 2026. They discussed defense aid and Ukraine’s future security. European officials will discuss security guarantees outside the main talks. Russia still opposes European participation in the main negotiations.
cards.hook: G7 diplomats meet as Ukraine peace talks begin.
cards.takeaway_english: The talks now have two rooms: direct negotiations and European security discussions.
cards.takeaway_korean: 회담은 직접 협상과 유럽 논의로 나뉘었다.

why_it_matters.english: European decisions could shape Ukraine’s long-term security guarantees.
why_it_matters.korean: 유럽의 결정은 우크라이나 안보 보장에 영향을 준다.

why_it_matters.english: The war has killed soldiers and civilians and disrupted energy supplies.
why_it_matters.korean: 전쟁은 군인과 민간인을 죽이고 에너지를 흔들었다.

parties.label: G7 diplomats
parties.english: They discuss Ukraine’s defense, security assistance and Europe’s role.

parties.label: European governments
parties.english: They want a place in negotiations about Ukraine’s future security.

parties.label: Russia
parties.english: It wants talks limited to Russia, Ukraine and the United States.

views.label: Europe
views.english: German Foreign Minister Johan Wadephul says Europe must be at the negotiating table.
views.korean: 독일은 유럽이 협상에 참여해야 한다고 말한다.

views.label: United States
views.english: Marco Rubio says European involvement could help later, but not yet.
views.korean: 루비오는 유럽 참여가 아직 이르다고 말한다.

disagree.english: Russia opposes European participation, while Europe says no lasting solution can exclude it.
disagree.korean: 러시아는 반대하지만 유럽은 배제될 수 없다고 말한다.

cards.english_title: Dana White turns down Trump’s White House job
cards.korean_desc: 화이트는 정치에서 일하고 싶지 않다고 말했다. 트럼프는 11월 7일 제안하고 농담이라고 말했다. 백악관 대변인 자리는 10월 16일부터 비어 있다.
cards.english_desc: White said he does not want to work in politics. Trump first offered the job on November 7, then called it a joke. The press secretary position has been vacant since October 16, 2026.
cards.hook: Dana White says no to Trump’s White House offer.
cards.takeaway_english: The White House still needs a press secretary, and White will keep running UFC.
cards.takeaway_korean: 백악관은 대변인이 필요하고 화이트는 UFC를 이끈다.

why_it_matters.english: The episode shows how an important White House communications role remains unsettled.
why_it_matters.korean: 중요한 백악관 대변인 자리가 아직 정해지지 않았다.

why_it_matters.english: It also shows the political closeness between Trump and White.

parties.english: He declined the press secretary job and said he does not want politics.

parties.label: Donald Trump

parties.english: The press secretary position remains vacant.

views.label: Trump

views.label: Dana White

disagree.english: The conflicting messages left people unsure whether the original offer was serious.
disagree.korean: 서로 다른 말 때문에 제안의 진심이 불분명했다.
